LightningComponentBundle.description: Horizontal lifecycle milestone timeline built from the account's Tasks and Events, with an inline detail panel. Action Plan playbook steps are excluded.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Heading shown at the top of the component.

property.name: maxMilestones
property.label: Maximum Milestones
property.description: Upper bound on the milestones shown. When the account has more, the most recent are kept and a note reports the full count. Capped at 100.

property.name: includeFuture
property.label: Include Future Activities
property.description: Show activities dated after today, such as scheduled reviews, as outlined nodes at the end of the timeline.

property.name: milestonesOnly
property.label: Lifecycle Milestones Only
property.description: Show only activities ticked as CX Milestone, so the timeline tells the lifecycle story instead of listing every logged call and email. If that field is not available to the running user, every activity is shown instead of an empty card.

property.name: emptyMessage
property.label: Empty State Message
property.description: Message shown when the account has no milestones to plot.
property.default: No lifecycle milestones yet. Logged calls, emails and meetings on this account will appear here.
